teaser.en: Its leaves are a vegetable in their own right, *bwere*, and a wild bean is even named after the way it spreads.
teaser.sw: Majani yake ni mboga kamili yenyewe, *bwere*, na kuna hata kunde-pori iliyopewa jina kutokana na jinsi inavyotambaa.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ni mboga yenye, *bwere*, na hata mmea mmwenga wa tsaka wa jamii ya kunde ukaihwa dzina ririrolavywa kula muyogbwe, kpwa sababu nao unaenea vivyo.

summary.en: *Muyogbwe* is the sweet potato, a creeping vine grown on ridges on sandy farms. Both its sweet tubers and its leaves, *bwere*, are eaten.
summary.sw: *Muyogbwe* ni kiazi kitamu, mtambaa unaopandwa kwenye matuta katika mashamba ya mchanga. Viazi vyake vitamu na majani yake, *bwere*, vyote huliwa.
summary.dg: *Muyogbwe* ni mmea unaoambala photsi (*sweet potato* kpwa Chingereza), unaophandwa kpwenye matuta kpwenye minda ya mtsanga. Viazivye vya mtswano na makodzage, *bwere*, vyosi nkuriwa.

about.en:
*Muyogbwe* is a creeping vine that spreads across the ground, rooting as it goes. Its leaves are heart-shaped or lobed, and it sometimes bears pale purple, trumpet-shaped flowers like a morning glory, to which it is related.

Below ground it forms swollen tubers with red, purple or cream skins and sweet flesh.
about.sw:
*Muyogbwe* ni mtambaa unaoenea ardhini, ukiota mizizi kadiri unavyosonga. Majani yake yana umbo la moyo au yenye mapengo, na wakati mwingine huzaa maua ya zambarau hafifu yenye umbo la tarumbeta, kama ya *morning glory* (jamii ya Ipomoea), ambayo ni jamaa yake.

Chini ya ardhi hutengeneza viazi vilivyovimba vyenye maganda mekundu, ya zambarau au ya rangi ya krimu, na nyama tamu.
about.dg:
*Muyogbwe* ni mmea unaoambala photsi na kuenea, uchilavya mizi phatu phosi unaphotsupa. Makodzage ni ga umbo ra moyo au genye mala, na wakati wanjina unalavya maruwa ga rangi ya zambarau ngushu-ngushu, ga umbo ra ndzumari, dza ga *morning glory*, ambayo ni ndugu zakpwe.

Tsini unahenda viazi virivyofutuka, vyenye magada ga kundu, ga zambarau au ga rangi ya maziya, na nyama ya mtswano.

where.en: Sweet potatoes are planted on ridges on sandy farms, where the loose soil lets the tubers swell. A sweet-potato patch is easy to spot by its low carpet of vines.
where.sw: Viazi vitamu hupandwa kwenye matuta katika mashamba ya mchanga, ambapo udongo laini huruhusu viazi kuvimba. Shamba la viazi vitamu ni rahisi kulitambua kwa zulia lake fupi la mitambaa.
where.dg: *Muyogbwe* unaphandwa kpwenye matuta kpwenye minda ya mtsanga, ambapho shangasheshe inaricha viazi vifutuke. Munda wa muyogbwe ni rahisi kuuona kpwa sababu mimeaye inafwinika tsi dza mcheka.

uses.en: The tubers are boiled or cooked in coconut milk. The leaves, *bwere*, are cooked as greens.
uses.sw: Viazi huchemshwa au hupikwa kwa tui la nazi. Majani, *bwere*, hupikwa kama mboga za majani.
uses.dg: Viazi nkuchemushwa au nkujitwa na huwi. Makodza, *bwere*, nkujitwa dza mboga.

culture.en: The way sweet potato creeps over the ground is so familiar that a wild legume has been named *yogweyogwe* after it, because it spreads in the same way.
culture.sw: Jinsi kiazi kitamu kinavyotambaa ardhini ni jambo linalojulikana sana kiasi kwamba mmea mmoja wa porini wa jamii ya kunde umepewa jina *yogweyogwe* kutokana nacho, kwa sababu unaenea kwa namna hiyo hiyo.
culture.dg: Namna muyogbwe unavyoambala photsi ni dzambo ra kawaida sana hata mmea mmwenga wa tsaka wa jamii ya kunde ukaihwa *yogweyogwe*, dzina ririrolavywa kula muyogbwe, kpwa sababu nao unaenea vivyo.

names.en: Digo: *muyogbwe* in Mgombato and *myogwe* in Pakia. The leaves are *bwere* or *matamberi*; *matamberi* is close to the Tanzanian Swahili *matembele*. Swahili: *kiazi kitamu*. English: sweet potato. Scientists call it *Ipomoea batatas*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *muyogbwe* katika Mgombato na *myogwe* katika Pakia. Majani ni *bwere* au *matamberi*; *matamberi* linakaribiana na neno la Kiswahili cha Tanzania *matembele*. Kiswahili: *kiazi kitamu*. Kwa Kiingereza: *sweet potato*. Wanasayansi huuita *Ipomoea batatas*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *muyogbwe* kpwenye Mgombato na *myogwe* kpwenye Pakia. Makodza ni *bwere* au *matamberi*; *matamberi* ni phephi na *matembele* ya Chiswahili cha Tanzania. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *kiazi kitamu*, kpwa Chingereza *sweet potato*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Ipomoea batatas*.

reason.en: A wild Ipomoea of the beach
reason.dg: *Ipomoea* ya tsaka ya mtsanga wa pwani

reason.en: Cassava, the other main root crop
reason.sw: Muhogo, zao kuu lingine la mizizi

reason.en: Cowpea, another crop eaten for its leaves
reason.sw: Kunde, zao lingine linaloliwa kwa majani yake

definition.en: Sweet potato leaves; another Mgombato word alongside matamberi.
definition.sw: Majani ya kiazi kitamu; neno lingine la Mgombato pamoja na matamberi.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muyogbwe; neno ranjina ra Mgombato phamwenga na *matamberi*.

mgombato: bwere (ma) sweet potato leaves; majani ya viazi tamu. (See: matamberi)
matamberi sweet potato leaves; majani ya viazi vitamu (Tz). (See: bwere)
